title: strict cutoff comparison: positive endpoint
statement:
Let C be an abelian category and L a nonnegative cochain complex. For 0 < a < b, the specified cokernel comparison q is a quasi-isomorphism. The cutoffs, compatibility and projection equation are precisely:
theorem verticalCutoff_column_quasiIso_strict_positive
    (L : CochainComplex C ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a < b) (ha : 0 < a)
    (g : (verticalCutoff a).obj L ⟶ (verticalCutoff b).obj L)
    (hg : g ≫ (verticalCutoffι b).app L = (verticalCutoffι a).app L)
    (q : cokernel g ⟶ (verticalWindow a b).obj L)
    (hq : cokernel.π g ≫ q = HomologicalComplex.restrictionMap
      (CochainComplex.truncLEMap
        (CochainComplex.πTruncGE (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) a) (b - 1))
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) : QuasiIso q

source.place: Section 12.15, canonical cochain truncations; endpoint argument by G2.

proof.text: Apply verticalCutoff_comparison_epi to the integer extension with t=b-1, then evaluate hq and use epi_of_epi_fac to prove every component of q epic. HomologicalComplex.epi_of_epi_f gives Epi q.

Apply verticalCutoff_comparison_kernel_twoTerm. Positivity implies a.toNat-1+1=a.toNat. The proved private acyclic_twoTerm lemma proves exactness at the first term from its invertible outgoing differential, exactness at the second from its invertible incoming differential, and exactness elsewhere from zero objects. Thus kernel q is acyclic.

Form the short exact sequence kernel q -> cokernel g -> W[a,b). Its exactness is ShortComplex.exact_kernel q; monicity and epimorphy are instances. In each natural degree n the homology exact sequence gives mono(H(q,n)) because H(kernel q,n)=0 and epi(H(q,n)) because H(kernel q,n+1)=0. Mathlib isIso_of_mono_of_epi and quasiIso_iff conclude QuasiIso q.
